correctness.rationale: The rank-one idempotent parametrization P=uv^T with v^Tu=1 and q-1 representations per projector gives, after affine-line character orthogonality, the precise multiplier q times the sum of phases over distinct F_q eigenlines of A. Scalar, Jordan, split-distinct and irreducible quadratic similarity classes have exact numbers q, q(q^2-1), q^2(q^2-1)/2 and q^2(q-1)^2/2. Split differences in trace fibres yield all stated 2q cos(pi*j/p) values and characteristic-two extra zeros. Singular values of unnormalized convolution are multiplier moduli. Independent exact field-frequency enumeration for q=2,3,5 confirms complete spectral multiplicities; this is corroboration, while the parameter/classification proof works for all finite fields.
